text.en: The old Shrine housed the image of Our Lady of Peñafrancia before the basilica was built.
The Traslación procession begins here and carries the image to Naga Metropolitan Cathedral.
The Shrine became a parish on October 30, 1973, with Fr. Concordio Sarte as its first parish priest.
Its forecourt contains a monument honoring Miguel Robles de Covarrubias, who introduced the local devotion.
